newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

A fresh polarisation is taking place in the country's political arena under the stewardship of the ruling Awami League and the main opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party. The two parties have revived contacts with their old allies to consolidate respective position in the backdrop of differing views.

Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said in a meeting with intellectuals on Friday that party and government should act as separate entities. The intellectuals suggested that all logical issues should be projected in a positive way.

A presidium meeting of the Jatiya Party scheduled for Thursday could not be held due to lack of quorum. Meanwhile, a party press release on Friday said thet Jatiya Party chairman HM Ershad had relieved Zinat Hossain of her position in the party presidium.

Hundreds of passengers including Hajj pilgrims remained stranded at Zia International Airport (in Dhaka) on Friday as all flights to the West overflying India were suspended following a strike by Indian air traffic control.
Shipping Minister ASM Abdur Rab has said the government is taking steps to expand the country's two sea ports to international standard.
